response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong technical leadership, distributed systems expertise, and hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP, event-driven platforms). However, his background is more generalist (web, mobile, embedded) with limited direct fintech or high-stakes regulated AI experience. His most recent role (re:cinq) shows promise but lacks depth in multi-agent AI architectures for fintech operations like real-time credit risk or trade decisioning.
strengths: Proven leadership in scaling engineering teams and delivering production-grade distributed systems (e.g., re:cinq, Dunnhumby)
Experience with event-driven architectures, microservices, and real-time data processing (Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
Direct involvement in AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows at re:cinq) and open-source contributions demonstrating technical depth
concerns: No explicit fintech infrastructure experience (credit, payments, or regulatory compliance) in the resume
Limited demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes commercial environments
Most recent roles focus on generalist software engineering rather than specialized agentic AI or fintech architecture
